hits.title: SUPERAGENT AI unveils platform 2.0, delivering a unified autonomous workforce for independent insurance agencies.
hits.snippet: [launches | 2026-04-30] SUPERAGENT AI, Inc. launched SUPERAGENT 2.0 on Apr 30th '26. SAN FRANCISCO, April 30, 2026 /PRNewswire-PRWeb/ - SUPERAGENT AI, Inc. today announced the general availability of SUPERAGENT 2.0, a comprehensive platform update that transitions the software from a n AI feature set into a unified autonomous workforce for independent insurance agencies.
hits.summary: SUPERAGENT AI, Inc. launched SUPERAGENT 2.0 on Apr 30th '26.
